claims.text: When an Application names no tool, Argo CD detects it from the source folder's files: a kustomization.yaml (or .yml / Kustomization) means Kustomize; otherwise a plain directory. apps/staging.yaml names no tool, so it needs no change.
claims.source_hint: argo-cd.readthedocs.io: User Guide > Tools > Tool Detection; User Guide > Kustomize

claims.text: At stage-3 apps/staging.yaml names path envs/staging (Gitea config repo, main) and syncPolicy.automated with selfHeal and prune: true; no tool. apps/ holds staging, edge-staging, policies-staging, traefik: none syncs envs/production.

The script moves staging's manifests to base/ except sealed-* (kept) and api-configmap.yaml (removed), removes envs/production; config_take writes each kustomization.yaml from config-repo-kustomize/ into the local copy .gitops/donhang-config, minus files it lacks. One commit, pushed.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang scripts/k8s/kustomize-config-repo.sh lines 21-44; scripts/lib/gitops.sh config_repo, config_take (lines 78-96); outputs/stage-3/scripts/k8s/kustomize-config-repo.txt

claims.text: Merge patch spec.syncPolicy.automated: null removes automated sync; Argo CD then only reports differences. config_commit commits, pushes; app_refresh sets argocd.argoproj.io/refresh so Argo CD compares now, not at its periodic repo check; config_head --verify prints the full commit id.
claims.source_hint: argo-cd.readthedocs.io: Automated Sync Policy; refresh annotation; examples/don-hang scripts/lib/gitops.sh config_commit, app_refresh, config_head at stage-3

claims.text: Before the sync, Argo CD marks exactly three objects OutOfSync: ConfigMap api (no longer rendered), ConfigMap api-<hash> (new) and Deployment api (envFrom now names the generated ConfigMap); after the sync one ConfigMap api-<hash> remains and the api has one new ReplicaSet.

With prune: true in apps/staging.yaml, the automated sync deletes an object whose manifest left the rendered source (the old ConfigMap api); the changed Pod template of Deployment api starts a rollout, one new ReplicaSet.
claims.source_hint: argo-cd.readthedocs.io: Automated Sync Policy > Automatic Pruning; kubernetes.io: Concepts > Workloads > Deployments (rollout on .spec.template change)

claims.text: After the script's excerpt it applies apps/staging.yaml again (automated sync with prune back on) and waits for Synced, Healthy.

envs/production/kustomization.yaml at stage-3 holds an images entry per image with newTag and digest; the comment says promoting to production is one change there, the tag and digest deploy-verified.sh verified for staging.
A change to the base is part of every overlay's rendered output, so it reaches every environment whose Application syncs that overlay at its next sync.

ci.yml 337-352: runs only if some envs/*/kustomization.yaml exists (hashFiles); per overlay of config-repo-kustomize in Đơn Hàng's repo, empty sealed-*.yaml stand-ins, kubectl kustomize piped into the $KUBECONFORM image (v0.8.0), -strict -kubernetes-version 1.34.0 -. No CI on config-repo commits.
kubeconform validates Kubernetes manifests against the JSON schemas of the given Kubernetes version; '-' as the file argument reads from standard input; -strict rejects properties not in the schema.
claims.source_hint: github.com/yannh/kubeconform README: Usage (-strict: disallow additional properties not in schema; '-' reads stdin)

claims.text: Each Argo CD Application renders its own source, so one cluster can hold Applications from Helm charts (apps/traefik.yaml) and from Kustomize folders (apps/staging.yaml).
claims.source_hint: argo-cd.readthedocs.io: User Guide > Tools; examples/don-hang deploy/gitops/config-repo/apps/traefik.yaml, apps/staging.yaml

claims.text: Opinion: overlays for your own manifests installed a few times with few differences, charts for software others maintain (Traefik, the Ingress controller); a team installing its app many times with many settings, or shipping it, may prefer a chart whose values file lists the settings to change.
claims.source_hint: outline item 6; helm.sh: Chart Best Practices > Values

claims.text: Try it: rendering envs/production prints one donhang-api image line containing the digest of line 24 (sha256:4f05…83d); after changing that digest the line contains the changed one; nothing is applied. base/api.yaml has the only donhang-api reference.
claims.source_hint: kubectl.docs.kubernetes.io: kustomization > images (digest); production kustomization.yaml line 24; base/api.yaml:33; run locally to confirm

claims.text: A Kustomize overlay's patches add or override fields on objects the base builds; kind and name stay unchanged unless allowKindChange/allowNameChange is set.
